text:
Kim: Requesting short-window unfreeze for NA slice to push v3.5.0-compat (TLS handshake regression). Window 18:00-18:15 UTC. Scoped to networking + serve-models. @Noah please confirm SRE checks.
Noah: On it. Quick pre-checks: LB config stable, certs valid, proxy rollout paused. Need canary + smoke. Abort if 5xx > 0.7% or p95 latency jumps > 400ms.
Kim: Keeping merges blocked except the hotfix PR. No data migrations.
deploy-bot: Received unfreeze request from Kim. Starting canary: v3.5.0-compat -> na-canary-02 (4%).
deploy-bot: Canary health checks: passing readiness, tracing attached, warming TLS sessions.
QA: Smoke script running against canary now.
QA: Smoke OK — HTTP 200, expected cert chain, p95 98ms. No handshake failures observed.
SRE-oncall: Observability hooks configured: TLS error counter, handshake latency, and connection churn dashboard. Paging threshold set: handshake_errors >= 1 within 1m.
Noah: Canary metrics @4m: errors 0.02%, p95 102ms, handshake_errors 0. Proceeding to 25% ramp.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% complete. Traffic redistributed.
QA: Post-25% smoke green. Minor increase in connection churn (spikes) but within tolerance; embedding calls unaffected.
Noah: Approving subgroup freeze lift for networking + serve-models. Rollback plan recorded: pin to v3.4.x and run `deploy-bot rollback --slice na --to v3.4.9` then `./roll_traffic_back.sh na 100`. Whoever triggers rollback must notify #incidents and ops-runner.
Kim: Final ramp scheduled in 90s. Hold other teams to no merges.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. v3.5.0-compat is live in na.
QA: Kicking off 30m expedited regression suite; will report anomalies.
SRE-oncall: Short-term watchlist: handshake_errors, p99 latency, LB drop rates. Alerts will page if critical.
Kim: I'll update release notes with one-line TLS regression fix and link to rollback playbook. Thanks team :thumbsup:
